summary: Release goes ahead on Monday the 20th only if the payment fix passes testing by Friday; Zhanna lines up a backup date; dropping in-app chat is still open.
consent_note: Demo data: synthetic voices, no real people.
title: Clinic app v2 release go/no-go

segments.speaker: Aigerim
segments.text: Let's start. This is the go or no-go for version two of the clinic booking app. Arman, where is the build?

segments.speaker: Arman
segments.text: The release candidate passed all automated tests last night. One bug is still open: on older Android phones the payment screen freezes after the card is entered.

segments.speaker: Aigerim
segments.text: How many users does that affect?

segments.speaker: Arman
segments.text: About six percent of our active users are on those phones. I can ship a fix by Thursday, but it needs a day of testing.

segments.speaker: Zhanna
segments.text: The marketing campaign is booked for Monday the twentieth. Moving it costs us the newsletter slot, and we would wait three weeks for the next one.

segments.speaker: Aigerim
segments.text: Then here is the decision. We release on Monday the twentieth, but only after Arman's payment fix passes testing. If the fix is not verified by Friday evening, we hold the release and Zhanna moves the campaign.

segments.speaker: Zhanna
segments.text: Agreed. I will prepare a backup date with the newsletter team by Wednesday, just in case.

segments.speaker: Arman
segments.text: I will have the payment fix ready for testing by Thursday noon.

segments.speaker: Aigerim
segments.text: One more risk. Our support team has only two people for launch week. If sign-ups spike, response times will slip.

segments.speaker: Zhanna
segments.text: Could we ask the sales team to cover chat support for the first three days?

segments.speaker: Aigerim
segments.text: Maybe. I will ask the head of sales today and confirm by tomorrow. Let's also consider dropping the in-app chat for launch, but nobody decided that yet.

segments.speaker: Arman
segments.text: One last thing: we should turn on crash reporting before release. I'll do that this week.

segments.speaker: Aigerim
segments.text: Good. So: fix by Thursday, verify by Friday, release Monday. Thanks everyone.
